string.text: Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Frame made of tougher polymer deforms less when the gun fires, which improves durability.
Combines the functions of narrow beam tactical flashlight and laser sight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Reduces overall weight of the firearm by replacing the standard magazine with a lightweight counterpart.
Modification of the case ejector reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm, which improves reliability.
Improves obturation and muzzle velocity thanks to tighter lock-up.
System integrated into the slide significantly reduces felt recoil, making the shooting more comfortable and accurate.
Precise adjustment of the internal parts and reduction of play in the chamber improves accuracy.
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting a 9x19mm suppressor.
Barrel with a faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity.
Decreases bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Reconfiguration of the trigger assembly with improvement of various parts gives a crisp break with a shorter, smoother trigger take-up, leading to faster follow-up shots, at the cost of durability.
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Grip panels specially picked to better fit the preferences of a particular shooter. Improves handling.
More wear-resistant, making the firearm more durable.
